fetch_review.note: fetched_content_supports_claim=true applies to the AS-SHIPPED corrected claim above (Fandom wiki synopsis), not the original trailer-specific wording -- neither fallback path could confirm the ORIGINAL claim as a Trailer-4-specific visual moment, which is why it was corrected before shipping rather than sent as-is. Investigation detail: (1) TEXT-ARTICLE PATH -- fetched Mystiqora's trailer-breakdown article (mystiqora.com, published 2026-07-13) fresh tonight; it confirms Jae Lee's introduction and discusses Vein's return, but explicitly frames Vein's return as UNCONFIRMED/theorized ('I'm still not convinced we've seen the real Vein... The trailer intentionally refuses to explain whether he survived'), says nothing about Qiao Ling's powers, and -- critically -- its own July 13 publish date predates Trailer 4 (released Aug 10-11 per the Outlook Respawn / Wibu X / ComicBook.com fetches already in this package's sources), meaning it is describing an EARLIER trailer, not the one actually cited in the VO/sources. Also fetched the Outlook Respawn article (respawn.outlookindia.com, published 2026-08-13) specifically about Trailer 4 itself; it confirms 'deeper connections with Vein' and introduces 'a new antagonist, Jae Lee' in general season terms, but does not mention Qiao Ling's powers at all and does not describe specific trailer visuals for either detail. No text source confirms all three Trailer-4-specific details together. (2) DIRECT VIDEO REVIEW PATH -- fetched the actual Trailer 4 YouTube page (the same URL already cited in this package's sources list) with a targeted extraction prompt for timestamped evidence of Jae, Vein, and Qiao Ling's powers specifically. Result: one fan comment timestamped at 0:26 references Jae investigating something ('WAIT SO JAE WAS INVESTIGATING A YUAN'), partially supporting the Jae detail; zero timestamped comment or description text referenced Vein or Qiao Ling's powers at all. This fetch only surfaces the video's text layer (comments/description), not actual frame-by-frame visual content, so it cannot honestly be represented as full frame-level trailer review either. CONCLUSION: 'Jae joins the investigation' has partial support (general season synopsis via the Fandom wiki already cited in this package, plus a fan-comment timestamp). 'Vein returns' and 'Qiao Ling's photograph-based powers' expanding are genuinely confirmed as SEASON 3 FACTS by the show's own official synopsis (linkclick.fandom.com/wiki/Link_Click_(Donghua)/Season_3, already fetched and cited for a different claim in this same package: 'With Vein's return and Qiao Ling's awakening powers, Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang gradually uncover the secrets of the Bahati fire case') -- but NOT as a Trailer-4-specific visual claim, which is what the original VO asserted via 'per the trailer breakdown.' This keeps only what is genuinely source-backed (the season-level synopsis fact, correctly attributed to the synopsis rather than the trailer) and drops the unconfirmed superlative ('territory she's never used before') and the false trailer-specific attribution.
